title: Erdal İnönü at 100: From the Sphere to the Plane
summary: On the centennial of Erdal İnönü's birth, this article reflects on his scientific legacy and his role in shaping modern theoretical physics in Türkiye. We briefly discuss his life, scientific vision, and contributions to academic institutions, and then turn to his most celebrated scientific achievement: the İnönü-Wigner contraction. Through the simple geometric example of a sphere becoming a plane, we present an accessible introduction to this important idea and its significance for modern physics.
